mappings.reason: Awarded knowledge is ideal op-amp infinite bandwidth = all frequencies amplified equally. No active lesson teaches op-amps. Closest active home is AC period/frequency/peak voltage which teaches frequency response vocabulary.

Awarded knowledge is ideal op-amp zero output impedance = no drop in output voltage with current. No active lesson teaches output impedance. Closest active home is AC resistive-load voltage/current lesson.
Awarded knowledge is non-inverting gain 1+Rf/Rin = 6.0. Removed op-amp electronics has no active lesson. Closest active home is AC voltage concepts under alternating currents.
Awarded knowledge is Vin = Vout/gain = 0.33 V. Op-amp application with no active coverage. Closest active home is same AC voltage-ratio lesson as gain.
Awarded knowledge is saturated maximum Vout = 5.0 V. Op-amp saturation is legacy electronics with no active lesson. Closest active home is AC peak-value lesson.

Awarded knowledge is R=(5.0-2.2)/0.020=140 ohm to limit LED current from saturated op-amp. Op-amp supply is legacy; closest active pedagogical home is diode/rectification lesson which explicitly teaches diode conduction.
